steps.text: Hey 😊 No alarm today, and I've decided getting dressed can wait until after breakfast ☕
That sounds suspiciously like a day off
It is 😌 No shift, no rushing anywhere this morning
I've opened the window and I'm drinking my coffee while it's still hot ☕
An unfamiliar experience
Very. I might become difficult to live with if I get used to it
Might?
Careful, I'm still deciding what to bring you
You look like you've already made peace with doing nothing
For the next twenty minutes, absolutely 😌
After that I'm going to the little market by the bakery
For something you need?
I need to leave the house without taking the same route for once
And I need something nice to eat with you later ❤️
I thought the pasta was something nice
It is. But the pasta doesn't count as dessert, no matter how much you compliment it
There goes my afternoon plan
You're getting the film I chose as well
I remember. I haven't arranged a mysterious power cut
You'd better not. I finally found one you haven't already told me the ending of
That happened once
You said the brother looked suspicious before he'd even spoken
He was wearing gloves indoors
He was washing dishes 😭
A convincing disguise
You can keep your detective work to yourself today
And I'm looking forward to actually seeing your face instead of wondering what the pause between messages means
The pause was mostly me trying to find the right words
I know. Today you can talk with your mouth full like a normal person
That I can manage
Good. I want a nice afternoon with you, not another serious meeting
You sounded so pleased last night that I nearly came over just to see the expression that went with it
You can inspect it this afternoon
I intend to. From very close up
I'll try not to look too smug
That would be a lovely change 😌
Are you staying in after that?
I haven't decided the whole evening yet
That's part of what I like about today
{{name:aiden}} sent me a picture of an arcade sign earlier
He's discovered somewhere else to complain about losing?
Apparently he was only making a helpful suggestion for my day off
That's how he gets you
I told him I already had plans with you this afternoon
He said to ask you whether the air hockey table counts as neutral ground
Only until he loses. Then the table is involved in a conspiracy
I might go later. I'd enjoy watching him try to explain that
Don't accept a best of three after you've already won
I'm writing that down 😌📝
The guy from yesterday sent me a message about that book we looked at
The one from the shop?
Yes. Apparently the first page was worth getting home for
I've only read the back cover, so I told him not to get smug about it yet
A promising start to a book club
It's mostly us finding new ways to avoid saying we want to keep talking
You've noticed, then
I might stop being subtle later
For now I told him I'm spending the afternoon with you. We'll talk this evening 😊
Good. I'd hate to share my excellent film commentary with a phone
I'm leaving it in my bag. For the commentary, not for you
Right, I should put actual clothes on before the bakery sells everything I want 😭
You haven't even decided what you want
That's why I need options
I'll await the investigation
Don't eat all your snacks before I get there
LATER THAT MORNING
Small update: the bakery woman remembered me
That sounds nice
She remembered that I always say I'm only buying bread
Less nice for your defense
She had already reached for a bigger bag
That's definitely not just bread
There is bread in there. Somewhere
I got two apple pastries for us, and enough other things to make the walk home worth it 🥐
You look happy
I am. I spent ten minutes looking at flowers without calculating where I needed to be next
Didn't buy any. Just enjoyed being there
We should have more days like that
Yes, we should
I'm going home to get the container, then I'll come over after lunch like we said
Half past one still okay?
Perfect
I'll put the drinks in the fridge
And leave my side of the sofa clear
I've been guarding it all morning
BEFORE SHE LEAVES HOME
Okay, I have the food, the film, and the lid that actually fits this time
You've packed for a small expedition
Only because you can't be trusted to own enough napkins
Bring yourself. Everything else is negotiable
That was nice enough to make me stop complaining
I'll enjoy the silence while it lasts
Not for long. I'm on my way ❤️
